name: qwen2.5-instruct-2024-09-18
what: Chat template of the Qwen2.5 Instruct models as first published, before Qwen's 2024-09-19 correction.

upstream.license_evidence: LICENSE file in the repository at this revision (Apache License 2.0, appendix filled in as Copyright 2024 Alibaba Cloud) and the card's license: apache-2.0

checks: Byte-identical to upstream: the chat_template field of tokenizer_config.json (JSON-decoded) in Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct at revision 52e20a6f5f47 equals the text (go run ./tools/feedbuild upstream re-checks it). Last checked 2026-10-14.

Socair's chat-template check (defilantech/socair@ddfe650b5f50, the RealTemplates corpus gate, 2026-10-14): PASS, with no code reach and no content-conditional injection; rendered 6 of 6 probe conversations; text it adds of its own: the default system prompt "You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant." when the conversation has none, and Hermes-style tool-call instructions when tools are given; nothing is added under a content condition.
notes: The qwen2.5-instruct text with one difference: the tool-call example in the system turn is written {{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}} with doubled braces, which render literally. Qwen replaced it with single braces in the next change to tokenizer_config.json (2024-09-19). GGUF conversions made before then carry this text: Qwen's own Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF at revision 9217f5db79a2 does (tokenizer.chat_template of qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q4_0.gguf, read 2026-10-14). Conditions test roles, loop position, and whether tools or tool_calls are present; none tests message text.

review.means: A person read the whole template text at the pinned revision and confirmed that it only lays out the conversation it is given: it adds no instruction to the model beyond the publisher's own default system prompt and tool scaffolding, no branch adds text when a message contains a particular string, and it reaches nothing but the documented chat-template variables and filters. Byte identity with the upstream file and Socair's chat-template check are mechanical checks, listed under checks; they are not the review.
